paper_specified.raw_counts: same 611211 filtered cells and gene order as existing benchmark
paper_specified.selection: minimum validation loss in each stage
paper_specified.prompt: same-perturbation cells from allowed training contexts

execution.order: one fold at a time on both GPUs after all STATE scoring
execution.checkpoint_retention: best posttraining weights retained; pretraining intermediate removed only after successful posttraining; current full resume checkpoint in RAM
execution.checkpoint_storage: lossless ZIP-compressed completed STACK posttraining checkpoints; all payload bytes verified; current full optimizer resume in RAM

limits: PIE does not release the complete STACK training configuration; this is a local implementation of the described protocol, not a claim of exact author-run replication.

PIE does not specify small-group sampling. Our adapter retains all PIE conditions by padding groups below 128 cells with same-condition resampling, using 32 prompt cells and 96 matched-context control queries. Official complete blocks and losses are unchanged; all padded groups are recorded.

evaluation.delta: mean log1p(CP10k predicted cells) minus mean log1p(CP10k generated controls)
